review: Every full-resolution output was visually inspected, then the batch was compared side by side with recent done sets.

anchor.evidence: Both complete boots and head fit the frame. She has two gloved arms and ordinary human eyes, drooping lids, a small rounded nose and a soft bow mouth; a long single braid distinguishes the silhouette. The adult face is rounder and shorter than Grumpig’s longer full-lipped face, and softer than Cranidos’s angular eyes and nose. Also compared Roserade.

forms.evidence: Heavy has rounded overlapping shoulders and a thick layered forearm; mobility has swept split plates. Each opening keeps the same raised arm and extended opposite hand while exposing warm ivory-gold mechanical channels. No new carried weapon or second figure.

identity.evidence: Same long tawny braid, curtain fringe and drooping eye shape.

activity_location.evidence: She lifts a silver cloche above a strawberry pastry in a gilded rococo salon.

garments_exposure.evidence: Black-and-ivory puff-sleeve maid costume, full white apron and short skirt show the low neckline and thighs above stockings.

anatomy_text.evidence: One hand grips the lid knob and the other gathers the skirt; both wrists connect normally. Ornamental reflections on the silver lid and gilded walls contain no lettering.

composition_expression.evidence: Complete figure with angled torso and an amused open smile; one knee crosses slightly in a moving gesture.

identity.evidence: Long thick braid, curtain fringe and rounded nose retained.

activity_location.evidence: Both hands peel a mandarin beside a ceramic bowl on a wicker stool, surrounded by tall sunroom windows and plants.

garments_exposure.evidence: Ivory halter romper with rust spots has open shoulders, an open side of the back and short hems over bare thighs.

anatomy_text.evidence: Two hands meet the fruit with believable opposing thumbs and separated fingertips. Pots and bowl carry floral decoration without words.

composition_expression.evidence: Her half-lidded gaze looks toward the camera rather than fully away; she sits on a tiled bench rather than the planned perched stool.

identity.evidence: Same fringe and braid; widened eyes change expression while the cheek and nose proportions remain stable.

activity_location.evidence: Wet entry mat, shoe rack, open doorway and a patterned umbrella establish her rainy arrival; hands hold the raincoat edges.

garments_exposure.evidence: Short clear open raincoat, cropped tank and rust wrap miniskirt leave collarbones, abdomen and thighs visible.

anatomy_text.evidence: Two connected hands grip the coat, fingers curl consistently; umbrella spirals, shoe rack and clothing have no lettering.

composition_expression.evidence: High camera and surprised raised brows/open mouth are present, but the image includes thighs and knees rather than ending at the waist. The umbrella is open beside the door rather than visibly flipped.

diversity.evidence: Full-body theatrical serving in an apron dress, seated fruit peeling in a halter romper, and high-angle raincoat removal at the doorway are distinguishable in place, main hand activity, clothing construction and posture. Compared actual images side by side: Grumpig’s clutch/jewelry/beach trio and the other recent dock/kitchen/music, bed/travel/laundry and orchard/racing/craft trios do not repeat this composition.
